It's much less spicy now.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Charred Peppers are a type of [[Roasted Food]], being the result of Spicy Peppers that have made contact with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} The roasting process is said to remove some of the spiciness of the Pepper. [[Link]] can heal three quarters of a [[Heart]] by eating a Charred Pepper. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Charred Peppers reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Roasted Food]], which are created when [[Spicy Pepper]]s come into contact with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. Following the roasting process, the Pepper's spiciness is reduced. When [[Link]] eats a Charred Pepper, he heals three quarters of a [[Heart]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Roasted Food * Spicy Pepper }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
